parameters.label: vWAN Hub

parameters.name: TCP_Connection_Test
parameters.query:
resources
| where type contains 'microsoft.network/networkwatchers/connectionmonitors'
| extend workspace=properties.outputs[0].workspaceSettings.workspaceResourceId
| extend testType=properties.testConfigurations[0].protocol
| where testType=='Tcp'
| project id
parameters.label: TCP Connection Test

content.query:
// Run query to see results.
resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets"
| where id == "{VMSS_API_GW}" or id == "{VMSS_Backend_App}"
| extend nic_an = properties.virtualMachineProfile.networkProfile.networkInterfaceConfigurations[0].properties.enableAcceleratedNetworking
| extend imageReference = properties.virtualMachineProfile.storageProfile.imageReference
| extend AcceleratedNetworking = case(
    nic_an == true, 'Enabled',
    nic_an == false, 'Disabled',
    'Unknown'
)
| extend VMSize = sku.name
| extend VMTier = sku.tier
| extend VMCapacity = sku.capacity
| extend NIC_DNS = properties.virtualMachineProfile.networkProfile.networkInterfaceConfigurations[0].properties.dnsSettings.dnsServers
| project id, resourceGroup, location, AcceleratedNetworking, VMSize, VMTier, VMCapacity, NIC_DNS,imageReference
content.title: Virtual Machine Scale Sets Config

content.query:
// Run query to see results.
resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets"
| where id == "{VMSS_API_GW}" or id == "{VMSS_Backend_App}"
| extend subnetId = properties.virtualMachineProfile.networkProfile.networkInterfaceConfigurations[0].properties.ipConfigurations[0].properties.subnet.id
| extend vnetName = split(substring(subnetId, 0, indexof(subnetId, '/subnets/')), '/')[8]
| extend vnetId = substring(subnetId, 0, indexof(subnetId, '/subnets/'))
| join kind=inner (resources | where type =~ "microsoft.network/virtualnetworks") on $left.vnetId == $right.id
//| where id == "/subscriptions/xxxxxbde4fd8233/resourceGroups/cyclecloud-workloads/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/vnet-cc-workloads"
| extend vnetEncryptionEnabled = case(isnotnull(properties.encryption.enabled),properties.encryption.enabled,"False")
| extend vnetDdosProtectionEnabled = case(isnotnull(properties.enableDdosProtection),properties.enableDdosProtection,"False")
| extend DnsServers = case(isnotnull(properties.dhcpOptions.dnsServers),properties.dhcpOptions.dnsServers,"Not Set")
| extend flowTimeout = case(properties.flowTimeoutInMinutes >= 1,properties.flowTimeoutInMinutes,  "Disabled")
| project id=id1, resourceGroup=resourceGroup1,location=location1,vnetEncryptionEnabled,vnetDdosProtectionEnabled,DnsServers,flowTimeout
content.title: Virtual Networks Config

content.query:
// Run query to see results.
resources
| where id == "{LoadBalancer_API_GW}" or id == "{LoadBalancer_Backend_App}"
| extend lbRules = properties.loadBalancingRules
| mv-expand lbRules
| extend lbRuleName = lbRules.name
| extend lbRuleProtocol = lbRules.properties.protocol
| extend lbRuleFrontendPort = lbRules.properties.frontendPort
| extend idleTimeoutInMinutes = lbRules.properties.idleTimeoutInMinutes
| extend enableFloatingIP = lbRules.properties.enableFloatingIP
| extend enableTcpReset = lbRules.properties.enableTcpReset
| extend disableOutboundSnat = lbRules.properties.disableOutboundSnat
| extend loadDistribution = lbRules.properties.loadDistribution
| project id, location, resourceGroup, sku=sku.name,skuTier=sku.tier,Rule=lbRuleName,Protocol=lbRuleProtocol,Port=lbRuleFrontendPort,idleTimeoutInMinutes,enableFloatingIP,enableTcpReset,disableOutboundSnat,loadDistribution
content.title: Load Balancer Rules Config

content.query:
// Run query to see results.
resources
| where id == "{LoadBalancer_API_GW}" or id == "{LoadBalancer_Backend_App}"
| extend frontEndConfigs = properties.frontendIPConfigurations
| mv-expand frontEndConfigs
| extend publicIPid = tostring(frontEndConfigs.properties.publicIPAddress.id)
| project FrontEndName=frontEndConfigs.name, publicIPid
| join kind=inner (resources | where type =~ "microsoft.network/publicipaddresses") on $left.publicIPid == $right.id
| extend IPAddress=properties.ipAddress
| extend PublicIPSku=sku.name
| extend PublicIPTier=sku.tier
| extend PublicIPIdleTimeout=properties.idleTimeoutInMinutes
| extend PublicIPAllocation=properties.publicIPAllocationMethod
| extend PublicIpTags=properties.ipTags
| project id=publicIPid,LoadBalancer=name, FrontEndName, IPAddress, PublicIPSku, PublicIPTier, PublicIPIdleTimeout, PublicIPAllocation, PublicIpTags
content.title: Load Balancer FrontEnds Config

content.query:
NWConnectionMonitorTestResult
| where ConnectionMonitorResourceId == "{TCP_Connection_Test}"
| project TimeGenerated,DestinationIP,Min=MinRoundTripTimeMs,Avg=AvgRoundTripTimeMs,Max=MaxRoundTripTimeMs
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: TCP Connection Test (ms)
